edges.notes: Clang selects libc++ as the C++ standard library with -stdlib=libc++ and links against libc++ objects in typical LLVM-oriented builds.
lld links final binaries that pull libc++ (and often libc++abi) from the LLVM toolchain stack.
Substitutable C++ standard library implementations in Clang/GCC-centric flows (libc++ vs libstdc++).
Substitutable C++ standard library implementations across platforms (LLVM libc++ vs MSVC msvcp*.dll on Windows).
libc++ builds on the platform C library for low-level POSIX/C runtime services on GNU/Linux targets.
Alpine and other musl-based stacks can ship Clang with libc++ layered on musl.
Clang with libc++ can target FreeBSD triplets with libc++ layered on FreeBSD libc in consistent sysroots.
Clang with libc++ may target OpenBSD triplets with libc++ layered on OpenBSD libc where toolchains align.
Clang with libc++ may target NetBSD triplets with libc++ layered on NetBSD libc where toolchains align.
Clang with libc++ may target DragonFly triplets with libc++ layered on DragonFly libc where toolchains align.
Clang with libc++ may target illumos triplets with libc++ layered on illumos libc where toolchains align.
Clang with libc++ targets Android NDK triplets with libc++ layered on Bionic in typical NDK C++ flows.
Clang with libc++ may target embedded triplets with libc++ layered on newlib in specialized LLVM vendor flows.
Clang/LLVM may link libc++ above wasi-libc sysroots in wasm32-wasi and related WASI targets.
Clang libc++ may target uClibc-backed embedded Linux sysroots when configured.
Clang libc++ may target dietlibc-backed minimal Linux sysroots in rare custom flows.
Clang can link libc++-built objects with GNU ld when lld is not used.
ELF objects and shared libraries carry libc++ symbols on typical Unix targets.
Debug info for libc++-using binaries is expressed in DWARF alongside Clang output.
C++ interoperates with C ABIs provided by the platform C library under libc++-compiled programs.
GDB debugs binaries linked against libc++ when debug info and sysroot are consistent.
LLDB is the native debugger pairing for Clang + libc++ stacks.
LLVM ships libc++ for RISC-V targets in cross and native LLVM toolchains.
Typical libc++ deployments link libc++abi for Itanium C++ ABI facilities (exceptions, RTTI, static init) on LLVM toolchains.
